description: Prior notification for the demolition of three buildings
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The hereby approved demolition must be completed within 5 years beginning from the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed demolition shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the documents submitted (Demolition checklist, Ferrari Demolition statement, Site plan showing buildings to be demolished and Site plan received: 11th February 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
